decision: Material advantage of the direct estimator on this fixed recipe, conditional on the three trained seeds.
limitations: CIs over parents condition on three paired fits; n=3 paired training-seed t interval separately conditions on these parents and is fragile. Neither estimates joint over bank and seed.

Neither estimator is an encoder-independent bound; one architecture and critic, fixed learning rate, optimizer, update cap, varying statistical work per step. No inference about other shell targets or global optimality.
The decoder log-score gain is a proper operational measure of relevance, not an unbiased MI point estimate. Prior historical TRAIN reuse makes this exploratory.
